# 🐛 Bug Report

## Environment
Commit, browser/version, OS/device, viewport, player count and board dimensions.

## Summary
Describe defect.

## Reproduction
1. Starting board and active player.
2. Exact sequence of coordinates/moves.
3. Action that exposes the failure.

## Expected vs actual
Describe the exact board and turn state expected and observed.

## Board fixture
Provide a minimal owner/count matrix for relevant cells.

## Evidence
Screenshots, console output or recording. Remove private data.

## Impact
Severity, frequency, workaround and affected configurations.

## Regression test
Name the deterministic test that should prevent recurrence.
